subject: [PATCH] iomap: release the folio batch on iomap callback failures

reviews.author: Brian Foster
reviews.summary: Reviewer suggested merging the patch into an existing iomap iter rework series to avoid a nontrivial merge conflict, proposing either folding it in as a preparatory patch or submitting a v5 of the series separately.
reviews.raw_body:
That's perfectly fine with me if you're Ok with doing that and nobody
otherwise objects.

Brian

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary: Author agreed to fold the patch into an existing series as a preparatory patch and send it together with other changes, avoiding merge conflicts.
reviews.raw_body:
I'll wait a day for anyone to object, and if no one does, I'll send v5
tomorrow with your patch folded in.

Thanks,
Joanne

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch addresses a potential issue where iomap callback failures could lead to memory leaks by not releasing the folio batch. The patch aims to fix this problem by ensuring that the folio batch is released in such scenarios, thereby preventing memory leaks. To achieve this, the patch modifies the iomap code to properly handle callback failures and release the associated resources.
